system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
**CONFIDENTIAL – BUYER LEGAL ADVICE**  
**Project Kestrel – Seller SPA/Disclosure Letter vs. Wattlebridge Playbook**  

---

### 1.  Executive Summary
The Seller’s “FINAL” package **systematically undercuts every core protection** in the Wattlebridge playbook.  The Seller tries to lock in a **20 % cap / 18-month limitation / general-regime-for-everything** structure, **whole-data-room disclosure**, **blanket buyer-knowledge bar**, **post-completion Riverlark release**, **no funds-flow line for DD-005 bonuses**, and **no independent title evidence**—and then declares the matters “cleared” and “not to be re-opened.”  
**None of these positions have been agreed.**  Amelia Frost has given **no written authority** for any fallback positions.  We must reject the “pre-cleared” framing and re-open every [STANDARD] item that conflicts with the playbook.

---

### 2.  Material Departures & Required Push-Backs  

| # | Playbook Requirement | Seller Position (SPA / Disclosure Letter) | Gap / Risk | Required Action |
|---|----------------------|-------------------------------------------|------------|-----------------|
| **1** | **General cap 25 % / AUD 6 M** (20 % / AUD 4.8 M only with Frost written authority – **none given**) | Cl. 12.1: **20 % / AUD 4.8 M** – marked “STANDARD … FINAL … not intended to be re-opened.” | **AUD 1.2 M less protection**; Seller treats fallback as baseline. | **Reject 20 % cap.**  Red-line to 25 % / AUD 6 M.  Flag that no Frost authority exists for 20 %. |
| **2** | **De minimis AUD 5 k; basket AUD 50 k (first-dollar recovery once exceeded)** | Cl. 12.2: **De minimis AUD 25 k; basket AUD 250 k (excess-only recovery).** | 5× higher de minimis; 5× higher basket; **seller pays nothing until AUD 250 k+** (playbook: pays from dollar 1 after AUD 50 k). | **Red-line to AUD 5 k / AUD 50 k first-dollar.**  Excess-only basket is unacceptable. |
| **3** | **General claims period 24 months** (18 months only with Frost approval – **none given**) | Cl. 12.3/13: **18 months**; “any limitation … applies to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise.” | 6 months less time; **drags fundamental/title/fraud claims into 18-month bar** via catch-all phrase. | **Red-line to 24 months.**  Delete “applies to all Claims” sweep-up language. |
| **4** | **Fundamental/Title regime: 100 % cap, ≥6 years, outside general basket/de minimis/knowledge bar** | Seller proposes “capacity and title warranties subject to same caps and time limits as general warranties for administrative simplicity.” | **Eliminates separate fundamental regime**; title claims capped at 20 %, time-barred at 18 months, subject to basket/de minimis/knowledge bar. | **Insert standalone Fundamental Warranties clause** (100 % cap, 6+ years, no basket/de minimis, no knowledge qualifier). |
| **5** | **Fraud / wilful concealment / deliberate misconduct carved out of ALL caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance – no waiver** | Cl. 9.3/12.8/20.5: limitations, exclusive remedy, non-reliance apply to **“all Claims of any nature.”** | **Fraud etc. silently capped, time-barred, exclusive-remedy’d, non-relied-upon.**  Direct playbook violation. | **Add express carve-out** for fraud, wilful concealment, deliberate misconduct from every limitation provision.  State “notwithstanding any other clause.” |
| **6** | **Specific fair disclosure only – reject whole-data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure** | Disclosure Letter 1.1–1.2: **general disclosure of entire data room (DD-002 to DD-012), accounts, statutory registers, public registers.** | **Buyer deemed to know everything in 11 DD files + public records** – used to defeat warranty claims via knowledge bar. | **Delete general disclosure clauses.**  Require Seller to list specific disclosures against each warranty.  Retain only true specific disclosures (Bluefen, Riverlark, Ironquay, bonuses, incident, etc.). |
| **7** | **No blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion; any qualifier needs named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry; never excuses title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity** | Cl. 8.3: **“Buyer shall have no claim … of which Buyer or its advisers had knowledge, including any matter discoverable from the data room or public records.”** | **Blanket constructive-knowledge bar** tied to general disclosure above; **swallows title, capacity, fraud, indemnities.** | **Delete Cl. 8.3 entirely.**  If Seller insists on knowledge qualifier, limit to **actual knowledge of named Buyer individuals** after reasonable enquiry; **carve out title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnities.** |
| **8** | **Bluefen: effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied BEFORE Completion; reasonable endeavours insufficient** | Cl. 3/6.3: **reasonable endeavours; consent “satisfied on delivery of counterparty’s written consent.”**  Disclosure 2: **no final written consent, no evidence conditions satisfied.** | **No certainty consent obtained or conditions met**; Buyer bears risk of post-completion consent failure on ~30 % revenue customer. | **Make Bluefen consent a Condition Precedent** requiring (a) executed consent, (b) evidence cl. 11.3 conditions satisfied.  **Reasonable endeavours not enough.** |
| **9** | **Riverlark: current payout from Completion funds + effective security releases; post-completion release only with irrevocable undertaking + Frost approval** | Cl. 2/7: **release “following Completion.”**  Disclosure 3: **facility not repaid, no discharge.** | **AUD 3.2 M debt + security remain post-Completion**; Seller controls timing; no undertaking, no Frost approval. | **Require payoff at Completion from purchase price** (funds-flow line).  Security releases delivered at Completion.  If Seller refuses, **irrevocable undertaking + Frost sign-off mandatory.** |
| **10** | **DD-005 bonuses (AUD 420 k + on-costs) = specific funds-flow line item or Seller-funded; not silently excluded** | Funds flow: **“not separately itemised … matter for the Seller.”**  Disclosure 5: **not in funds flow; on-costs unstated.** | **AUD 420 k + payroll tax/super/on-costs** effectively deducted from price without transparency; Buyer may inherit liability. | **Insert specific funds-flow line** for AUD 420 k + on
=== END ADVICE ===
